I added a small "PARTNEŘI AKCE" line to the IG event post (`ig-event-square`). I couldn't confirm by eye how it looks: every screenshot came out as a tiny thumbnail, too small to see the new line.

**What changed** (`ui/2026/combine/Combine-kampan.tsx:722`):
- The line sits just above the yellow edge over the green bottom bar. It lines up on the left with the rest of the text in the post.
- It uses the same small mono caps style as the "KDY / KDE" labels, in the grey used for the post's body text, so it reads as quiet small print.
- Its id is `partneri-akce`.

**Worth checking in the studio:**
- **Tight spacing:** by my numbers, the line ends up about 15 px below the date and venue details. If that feels crowded, it can move down onto the yellow edge or into the bar itself.
- **Text only:** this is just the "Partneři akce" heading, with no partner logos. The print card has a 15-logo partner grid that could go here if you want the actual partners shown. On this post there's only room for one row of small logos.

**Left alone:** the canvas check reports one error at line 1268: an artboard id is written as an expression instead of plain text. That was already there before my edit and isn't part of this post, so I didn't touch it.
